completeness.scope: All literal-method ApiService.send calls, Request constructors and concrete HttpOperations.createRequest sites found by TypeScript AST across the published bundle sources, plus selected pinned SDK wrapper transport traces. CLI-local serve routes are listed separately.

reachabilityDefinitions.direct_cli_implementation: Network/request construction is in CLI implementation; method execution still depends on command and branch.
reachabilityDefinitions.direct_cli_method_reference: A method-name reference occurs in CLI source; generic names are ambiguous and this is not a typed call-graph proof.
reachabilityDefinitions.bundled_shared_method_reference: Referenced by another bundled shared method; command reachability unproven.
reachabilityDefinitions.bundled_method_no_callsite_found: Present in shared bundled service, no reference found; retain as unresolved scope rather than claim CLI use.
reachabilityDefinitions.bundled_sdk_wrapper: Actual shipped TS wrapper mapped to pinned SDK transport; command and flag reachability may remain unproven.

openObligations.summary: Resolve the full typed DI/polymorphic call graph. Shipped shared service methods and name-based references intentionally overapproximate command reachability; generic get/create/save/delete names are ambiguous.

Exercise legacy and SDK branches, org/admin/emergency-access paths, subscription/policy states, migration versions, and configured vs cross-instance Sends with the real pinned CLI. Presence in this inventory is not compatibility verification.

Upload and download URLs come from server responses or signed storage URLs. Their actual hosts/path/query combinations are open; records retain GET/PUT/POST methods and provenance rather than inventing finite endpoints.
CLI opens the web-vault SSO page and receives a localhost OAuth callback. Browser redirects and identity-provider endpoints are outside this static CLI HTTP extraction; no exhaustive SSO chain claim.

SDK records resolve actual TS wrapper calls to selected generated API methods and inspected handwritten HTTP. Unused generated APIs are excluded. Additional transitive SDK HTTP branches, external direct-import providers and dynamic adapters remain to be proven.

Personal API-key login uses identity client_credentials; organization API-key retrieval/rotation appears in shared services. No direct /public/* request was found in extracted CLI TS HTTP callsites. This does not establish absence through all SDK/dynamic branches or inventory the separate Bitwarden Public API.

Conditional string evaluation is a conservative static approximation. Optional queries are recorded symbolically and may be split into variants. Verify query/body/response semantics separately; this inventory does not prove wire shapes.
